title: What Fuchi and the crotchet worker already give us
summary: I read Fuchi (Mac, iPhone and iPad, and their shared package) and the crotchet worker it uses for AI, storage and push. In short: Fuchi already has the phone apps, the shared code, and a way to answer a question on the Mac. What's missing is reaching you when you aren't home, and any security.

checks.text: Fuchi's action round trip is almost a Review answer already. The phone sends actionRun(id, choice, text) and the Mac replies with actionResult. An action can offer choices and a typed-text prompt (ActionDescriptor, FuchiWire/Surfaces.swift:128). A card is an action with options and a note. Built 2026-10-17.

One shared Swift package and an extension system. FuchiWire (the protocol), FuchiSync (the backend client) and FuchiTheme are shared by Mac, iPhone and iPad. A feature is Extensions/<id>/{Core,Mac,Mobile} plus an extension.json. Review would be one more extension, not a new app.
The wire format is plain JSON lines ({"v":1,"channel":…}, FuchiWire/Frames.swift), so it doesn't care what carries it.
Fuchi's Mac app is already a menu-bar app, linked to the phone over Wi-Fi or USB, and it reconnects to known devices by itself.

Kazzi already syncs Mac and phone with no link at all. Both read and write the same four collections in the worker's store, cache-first, with offline writes queued and a pending count shown (WorkerLibrary). It works on a plane and away from home. The link only carries the last inch: pasting a prompt onto the Mac.
The crotchet worker can already push to a phone: /firebase/notify sends through FCM to APNs. Fuchi has a client for it (FuchiBackend.notify) but never calls it.

The link only works on the local network, and only while the phone app is open. The phone is the server (it listens on port 8765 and advertises over Bonjour) and the Mac connects to it; the app's only background mode is audio.

Nothing is secured. The link is plaintext TCP with no pairing ("anything on the LAN can drive ActionExecutor", SHELL_PLAN.md:29). Every worker endpoint is open with CORS *, and push goes to topics, which can be guessed. Authentication is Fuchi's open item B11.

The worker's relay is a polling mailbox in KV: a 5 s poll, 20 messages for 10 minutes, and two sends at once can lose one. Its own comment: "not for a live stream." /socket isn't a socket; it returns a stored LAN address.
On the phone, no notification has actions, and there are no widgets or Live Activities yet. There are only local Pomodoro notifications; widgets, Watch, Live Activities and Shortcuts are in IDEAS.md.
The worker's AI is single-turn Sonnet (POST /prompt): no streaming, no tools, and it turns "I don't know" answers into nothing.
